dose_adult.indication: Episódios maníacos do transtorno bipolar (Depakote, comprimidos de liberação retardada)
dose_adult.note: Dose máxima recomendada: 60 mg/kg/dia (por peso; não convertida para mg/dia). Aumentar o mais rápido possível até a menor dose eficaz; nos ensaios de mania aguda, o nível de vale ficou entre 50 e 125 mcg/mL.

cite.quote: The recommended initial dose is 750 mg daily in divided doses.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "The maximum recommended dosage is 60 mg/kg/day." e "patients were dosed to a clinical response with a trough plasma concentration between 50 and 125 mcg/mL"

cite.quote: Hepatic failure resulting in fatalities has occurred in patients receiving valproate and its derivatives. These incidents usually have occurred during the first six months of treatment.
Depakote is contraindicated in patients: • with hepatic disease or significant hepatic dysfunction

Valproate can cause major congenital malformations, particularly neural tube defects (e.g., spina bifida). In addition, valproate can cause decreased IQ scores and neurodevelopmental disorders following in utero exposure.
cite.note: Mesmo boxed warning: "Valproate should not be administered to a woman of childbearing potential unless other medications have failed to provide adequate symptom control or are otherwise unacceptable."

cite.quote: Cases of life-threatening pancreatitis have been reported in both children and adults receiving valproate.

Serious and sometimes fatal dermatologic reactions, including toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), Stevens Johnson syndrome (SJS), acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), and erythema multiforme (EM) have been reported with valproate treatment.

facts.note: O risco vem da plaquetopenia dose-dependente, da inibição da agregação plaquetária e de alterações da coagulação descritas na mesma seção.

cite.locator: seção 5.8 Bleeding and Other Hematopoietic Disorders
cite.quote: Evidence of hemorrhage, bruising, or a disorder of hemostasis/coagulation is an indication for reduction of the dosage or withdrawal of therapy.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Valproate is associated with dose-related thrombocytopenia." e relatos de "inhibition of the secondary phase of platelet aggregation, and abnormal coagulation parameters".

cite.locator: seção 7.2 Effects of Valproate on Other Drugs (Lamotrigine)
cite.quote: In a steady-state study involving 10 healthy volunteers, the elimination half-life of lamotrigine increased from 26 to 70 hours with valproate co-administration (a 165% increase). The dose of lamotrigine should be reduced when co-administered with valproate.
cite.note: Mesmo trecho: "Serious skin reactions (such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis) have been reported with concomitant lamotrigine and valproate administration."

facts.note: Alerta específico para idosos (ensaio em idosos com demência).

cite.quote: A significantly higher proportion of valproate patients had somnolence compared to placebo
cite.note: Mesma seção: "In elderly patients, dosage should be increased more slowly and with regular monitoring for fluid and nutritional intake, dehydration, somnolence, and other adverse reactions."

cite.quote: Since valproate products may produce CNS depression, especially when combined with another CNS depressant (e.g., alcohol), advise patients not to engage in hazardous activities

facts.note: A bula relata mortes, mas também recuperação com níveis muito altos; não quantifica a toxicidade.

cite.quote: Overdosage with valproate may result in somnolence, heart block, deep coma, and hypernatremia. Fatalities have been reported; however patients have recovered from valproate levels as high as 2,120 mcg/mL.
Serum liver tests should be performed prior to therapy and at frequent intervals thereafter, especially during the first six months

cite.locator: seção 5.8 Bleeding and Other Hematopoietic Disorders
cite.quote: measurements of complete blood counts and coagulation tests are recommended before initiating therapy and at periodic intervals

Since valproate may interact with concurrently administered drugs which are capable of enzyme induction, periodic plasma concentration determinations of valproate and concomitant drugs are recommended during the early course of therapy

monitoring.note: Alerta de classe dos antiepilépticos (não é boxed warning).

cite.quote: Patients treated with any AED for any indication should be monitored for the emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, and/or any unusual changes in mood or behavior.
Valproate should be discontinued at the first sign of a rash, unless the rash is clearly not drug related.
cite.note: Seção 17: "Advise patients of the early signs and symptoms of severe cutaneous adverse reactions and to report any occurrence immediately to a healthcare provider"
